name: PEI800-30/MIL-101(Cr) glycerin-free control, 2026 25 C dry conditional

evidence.basis: A finite-time digitized 25 C dry adsorption branch supports a conditional one-pool dry reference shape. The 333.15 K withheld-temperature failure is retained unchanged.
evidence.not_for: repairing or passing the failed 333.15 K representation, global caloric closure, humid coadsorption, hot CO2-rich vacuum equilibrium, shaped-device prediction, lifetime, CSS, annual production, hardware qualification or a measured winner.

shaped_material.basis: Measured source mol/kg loading on the dry activated composite is mapped to the shared 10 kg complete dry shaped inventory under an explicit unity loading-retention and mass-transfer assumption; this is not a final-composition or binder-free shaped-body claim.
shaped_material.binder_support: Nominal feed contains PEI and glycerin, but final composition and any pellet binder/support are not fully identified.
shaped_material.particle_geometry: Source particles are 425-825 micrometers in the breakthrough test; pellet density, binder and effective transport remain unavailable.

co2.basis: Digitized finite-time 25 C adsorption branch. The constant 70 kJ/mol hot shift is a named screening assumption because the source energies refer to a different amine/MIL system and do not close this material's equilibrium and calorimetry.

reference_curve.class: measured digitized finite-time 25 C adsorption branch

water.basis: No defensible reciprocal CO2/water equilibrium, hot humid law or shaped humid kinetics is represented. Water storage, rates, heat and adsorbed Cp are exactly zero; any nonzero RH is rejected.

kinetics.evidence_status: ASSUMED_LDF_SCREENING_SCALE plus assumed exact-zero inert rates: no intrinsic CO2 or inert-gas rates are measured. The CO2 LDF is a named 1e-4 s^-1 scenario in both directions.

sample_identity.class: measured source formulation with unresolved final composition
sample_identity.description: PEI800-30/MIL-101(Cr) glycerin-free control, 2026 25 C dry conditional

co2.class: measured finite-time digitized adsorption plus assumed hot transfer

co2_temperature_shift.failure_note: The 333.15 K withheld-temperature representation failure is neither repaired nor hidden by the 25 C scenario.

solid_cp.class: source table value selected for named scenario; conflict retained

thermal.statement: Selected the source-table composite Cp only for this scenario; the corrected figure and conditioning basis remain unresolved.

inert_gases.basis: No candidate-specific N2/O2 equilibrium, calorimetry or rates are available. The executable zeros are assumptions that affect gas retention and pumping; the true values remain null.

water.class: numerical structural mode; no physical coefficients

nominal_feed.interpretation: 30 wt% naming excludes glycerin from its denominator; normalized feed masses are calculated, not measured final composition or binder fractions

finite_time_conditioning.co2_pretreatment: 60 C and <0.1 mbar vacuum for 3 h

mass_mapping.source_loading_basis: per kg dry activated composite as reported
mass_mapping.executable_inventory_basis: per kg complete dry shaped inventory

regeneration_context.class: measured protocol, not a hot CO2-rich vacuum law

assumptions: The 25 C digitized adsorption branch is a finite-time source measurement and only a conditional dry reference shape.
A constant 70 kJ/mol hot shift is a named scenario assumption, not a fit or measured exact-material heat.
A 1e-4 s^-1 CO2 LDF rate in both directions is a named scenario assumption.
N2 and O2 Henry coefficients, heats and rates are exact executable zero assumptions because candidate-specific values are unavailable; true properties remain null.
The source-table composite Cp is selected for this scenario while its conflict with the corrected temperature-dependent figure is retained.
Nominal feed composition is not final composition, and the final PEI/glycerin split is unavailable.
Source mol/kg loading maps to complete dry shaped inventory under explicit unity retention and mass transfer; density, binder and effective transport remain missing.
Dry-only water handling has zero physical water storage, rates, heat and adsorbed Cp; nonzero RH is rejected.

uncertainty.statement: The 25 C reference curve is usable only as a conditional dry shape. The failed 333.15 K withheld test, composition discrepancies, Cp conflict, finite-time conditioning and missing shaped properties prevent model-ready status.

validity.co2: Conditional 25 C finite-time dry reference shape with named hot transfer.
validity.hot_holdout: Failed at 333.15 K; no repaired representation or model-ready claim.
validity.kinetics: CO2 rates are assumptions and inert rates are assumed exact zero.
validity.thermal: Table Cp is selected only for the scenario; figure conflict and shaped transport remain unresolved.
validity.water: Dry-only; any nonzero RH is rejected.
